_doc: Un portrait de chef par peuple : 4 expressions (neutre, cri, blessé, sourire). Générés directement dans la couleur du peuple (pas de recoloration). Le chef a le même look que les sprites de la carte (peau brun foncé, cheveux courts crépus foncés, bandeau noué couleur d'équipe, pas de casque) : seuls ses ornements d'or le distinguent de ses soldats. `regard` : sens du visage (Koush regarde à gauche, comme le prévoit le jeu, apps/game/src/drawn/assets.ts).
expressions: Shouting a battle cry, mouth wide open.

koush.chef: the King of Kush, a Nubian warrior king, in his forties
koush.design: Same people as the soldiers of the map sprites: dark brown skin, short dark tightly curled hair, a team-color headband knotted at the back of the head with its two ends trailing, no helmet. Chief's distinctions: short neat beard, team-color feathers tucked in the headband, gold broad collar, gold earrings, a team-color cloth draped over one shoulder.

carthage.chef: a Carthaginian general, in his forties
carthage.design: Same people as the soldiers of the map sprites: dark brown skin, short dark tightly curled hair, a team-color headband knotted at the back of the head with its two ends trailing, no helmet. Chief's distinctions: short neat beard, a round gold disc on the front of the headband, gold torque necklace, gold armbands, a team-color cloth draped over one shoulder with a gold round brooch.

kemet.chef: a general of ancient Egypt (Kemet), in his forties
kemet.design: Same people as the soldiers of the map sprites: dark brown skin, short dark tightly curled hair, a team-color headband knotted at the back of the head with its two ends trailing, no helmet. Chief's distinctions: clean-shaven, a gold band over the headband, gold broad collar, a cream linen tunic under a team-color sash.

aksoum.chef: the King of Aksum, an Ethiopian king, in his forties
aksoum.design: Same people as the soldiers of the map sprites: dark brown skin, short dark tightly curled hair, a team-color headband knotted at the back of the head with its two ends trailing, no helmet. Chief's distinctions: short beard, a gold crown band over the headband, a simple gold disc pendant, a cream cotton cloak with a team-color border on the shoulders.
